title: PG-13.1 Federation sites, sharing classes, disclosure (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP13 in memev: Federation sites, sharing classes, disclosure. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP13.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP04-02, WP06-03, WP09-01, WP09-02, WP10-01, WP12-02. Depends on contracts: SO-2.02, PG-09.1. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.02: WP13-01 enforces sharing classes at the publish boundary of a site; SO-2.02 governs retrieval and action time and takes none of it. Boundary with SO-2.12: WP13-03 (sites) is a prerequisite of federated computation. Boundary with SO-2.11 and SO-2.14: WP13 concerns sites of Memev; enterprise systems and multi-person project permissions stay with those contracts. Signed vault contract SO-09-A (cited by id only): the authorisation matrix at every entry point; WP13 enforces the publish boundary of a site and does not restate it. Build layer (owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the signed fold contracts SO-F-01, SO-F-04, SO-F-05, SO-F-07 (cited by id; delivered by pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2 on its branch) are the build layer. Each task below that overlaps them cites the fold id and keeps only what the fold does not cover. Tasks of this spec that name no fold contract have no fold overlap. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.description: Repo: memev. Enforces sharing classes at the publish boundary of a site only. The six replication classes, local only by default and the inheritance of the class by derived data are SO-F-05; the allow or deny decision per class is the evaluation function of SO-F-04; this task calls both at the publish boundary and defines neither a class list nor a policy format. Access control at retrieval and action time, and its default-deny rule, are SO-2.02 requirements 2 and 3; this task does not restate or implement them.
